meta.title: Independent verification desk — anonymous NNN property decision evidence

meta.privacy: No parcel address, APN, owner name, lease file, tenant unit identifier or owner financial figure appears anywhere in this dataset or the generated site. Placeholders only.
meta.policy: Only values transcribed from an official primary source are published. Anything not confirmed is left blank, marked UNVERIFIED, and published on the Flagged for Review page with the official portal where it must be checked privately.

unverified.label: Parcel address, APN / AIN, legal description
unverified.why: No identifier was supplied and personal/parcel identifiers must never appear on a public site.
unverified.discovery: Authorized adviser retrieves the deed and Assessor record offline; store only in the access-controlled workspace; publish no identifier.

unverified.label: Exact lease expiration date
unverified.why: Only a user-supplied 2030–2035 range exists; issuer filings do not publish a store-level lease expiry.
unverified.discovery: Private lease abstract of the executed lease and all amendments; reconcile with the notice calendar.

unverified.label: Renewal options, exercise windows and notice method
unverified.why: No executed lease or amendments supplied.
unverified.discovery: Counsel abstracts options, delivery address and notice mechanics; log each deadline privately.

unverified.label: Base rent, escalations and percentage rent
unverified.why: Subject lease is private; brand-level franchise disclosures are not the subject rent.
unverified.discovery: Lease abstract plus rent-roll reconciliation in the private workspace.

unverified.label: Guarantor, co-tenancy, assignment, ROFR, holdover clauses
unverified.why: No lease document supplied.
unverified.discovery: Clause-by-clause attorney abstract; note any change-of-control provisions.

unverified.label: Identity and credit of the actual tenant entity at this parcel
unverified.why: Issuer-level disclosures do not identify a specific franchisee or store.
unverified.discovery: Private estoppel certificate, corporate guaranty search and financial statements with authorized advisers.

unverified.label: As-is sale price and dated written offers
unverified.why: No verified arm's-length offers or comparable closed sales supplied.
unverified.discovery: Request at least three dated broker opinions and actual indications for as-is and renewed scenarios; record terms.

unverified.label: Short-lease discount from real quotes
unverified.why: No verified quote set for a short-lease QSR in central Los Angeles is available from official sources.
unverified.discovery: Solicit written quotes from licensed brokers for short-lease vs long-lease scenarios; keep quotes private, publish only an aggregate conclusion if ever appropriate.

unverified.label: Negotiated renewal rent and term
unverified.why: No renewal offer exists in the verified record.
unverified.discovery: Negotiate a written renewal term sheet privately; compare with sale case only after verification.

unverified.label: Capitalisation rate, discount rate and exit liquidity haircut
unverified.why: These are property- and investor-specific assumptions, not official published values for this parcel.
unverified.discovery: Derive from verified comparable sales and the owner's required return; label as assumptions in the model.

unverified.label: Adjusted basis, purchase date and depreciation schedule
unverified.why: Owner financial records are private and must stay offline.
unverified.discovery: CPA reconstructs basis and depreciation from private records; no figure is published.

unverified.label: Owner marginal tax rates, MAGI, entity type and loan balance
unverified.why: Owner-specific and personal; excluded from the public site by policy.
unverified.discovery: CPA computes privately; the calculator accepts inputs only in the reader's browser.

unverified.label: Assessed value and actual property tax bill for this parcel
unverified.why: Requires a parcel identifier that is not published.
unverified.discovery: Assessor and Treasurer lookups in the private workspace.

unverified.label: FEMA flood zone and elevation status for this parcel
unverified.why: Zone status is address-specific; no address is published.
unverified.discovery: Private MSC address search plus a flood elevation certificate and insurance quote.

unverified.label: CAL FIRE Fire Hazard Severity Zone for this parcel
unverified.why: Zone status is location-specific; 2026 SRA update is in public comment.
unverified.discovery: Private lookup in the official FHSZ viewer; record map date and version.

unverified.label: CGS seismic / liquefaction / fault zone status for this parcel
unverified.why: Zone status is location-specific.
unverified.discovery: Private EQ ZApp lookup plus geotechnical engineering review; note seller disclosure duties.

unverified.label: Engineering reports, insurance premiums, deductibles and exclusions
unverified.why: Private documents required; not available from official public sources.
unverified.discovery: Obtain property condition report, seismic assessment and at least two insurance quotes privately.

unverified.label: Combined stress of lost rent, repairs and exit liquidity
unverified.why: Joint stress requires unverified property inputs.
unverified.discovery: After engineering and insurance inputs exist, run the joint scenario in the versioned model; label all scenarios illustrative.

unverified.label: Trade-area boundary and consistent Census tract set
unverified.why: 'Central Los Angeles' is not a Census geography; no parcel anchor supplied.
unverified.discovery: Define a drive-time or ring trade area privately using the real parcel, then lock tract IDs and vintages.

unverified.label: Tract-level population, income and trend series
unverified.why: Tract IDs are not fixed; no tract-level value may be inferred from county/city proxies.
unverified.discovery: Query ACS 5-year and 1-year profiles for the locked tract set with a registered API key; keep regional figures alongside.

unverified.label: Local school attendance area and performance series
unverified.why: School assignment depends on the private parcel address.
unverified.discovery: Identify attendance boundaries privately; pull official enrollment and dashboard series for those schools.

unverified.label: Traffic counts adjacent to the parcel
unverified.why: Station selection requires a private location and date range.
unverified.discovery: Select District 7 stations privately; extract a multi-year AADT series and note PeMS upgrade limitations.

unverified.label: Competitor set and local planning actions
unverified.why: Requires the private address and case-number research.
unverified.discovery: Private competitor inventory and official case/zoning searches; record permit and entitlement history.

unverified.label: Zoning, land-use designation and entitlement status
unverified.why: Parcel-specific.
unverified.discovery: Private ZIMAS / zoning code lookup; verify community plan and any pending cases.

unverified.label: Versioned cash-flow back-test
unverified.why: Sufficient verified comparable transaction and lease history does not exist in the public record.
unverified.discovery: Once verified comps and lease history exist in the private workspace, version the model and back-test against realised outcomes.

unverified.label: Owner liquidity, diversification, income needs and risk tolerance
unverified.why: Personal information is excluded by policy; no owner-specific recommendation can be made publicly.
unverified.discovery: Private discussion with fiduciary advisers; keep notes offline.

unverified.label: Sufficient comparable history for a reliable projection system
unverified.why: No verified, property-specific comparable series was supplied.
unverified.discovery: Build a dated comparable ledger privately; do not publish a projection until it can be back-tested.

gates.requirement: All identifiers, lease files and owner finances held only in an access-controlled offline workspace; public site contains placeholders only.
gates.evidence: Privacy rule applied to every published row in this dataset.
gates.note: Highest urgency; a public static site is not access-controlled.

gates.gate: Gate 1 — Lease abstract and notice calendar
gates.requirement: Executed lease and amendments abstracted; all option and notice dates reconciled.
gates.note: Must be complete before any sale or renewal commitment.

gates.requirement: Lock a consistent Census tract set and retrieve tract-level series alongside regional figures.
gates.evidence: No parcel anchor; city/county proxies are published only as regional context.
gates.note: W-01 and W-12 cannot close without it.

gates.requirement: Private flood, fire and seismic zone status plus engineering and insurance review.
gates.evidence: Official portals identified; no parcel lookup performed.
gates.note: Regional hazard context must be replaced with parcel zone status.

gates.requirement: Dated as-is and renewed-case quotes; short-lease discount priced from real quotes.
CPA-verified basis, depreciation, debt and owner-specific rates.
gates.evidence: Only the tax rules are verified; owner inputs are private.
gates.note: Calculator accepts private inputs in-browser only.

gates.gate: Gate 6 — Versioned cash-flow model and back-test
gates.requirement: Verified inputs and sufficient comparable history; observations separated from assumptions.
gates.evidence: Model skeleton exists; back-test cannot run.
gates.note: Condition explicitly required before a projection is trusted.

gates.requirement: After-tax sale case and negotiated renewal case on the same valuation date.
gates.evidence: Mechanics and calculator published; no dollar result.
gates.note: Do not select a winner until G-1 to G-6 close.

gates.requirement: Joint stress of lost rent, repairs and exit liquidity plus natural-disaster scenarios.
gates.evidence: Scenario library published; magnitudes are unverified.
gates.note: Scenario magnitudes are assumptions, not observations.

gates.requirement: Owner and advisers choose a path with manageable, documented risk.
gates.evidence: No verified inputs; no recommendation published.
gates.note: Record the decision privately; publish only an anonymous summary.

decisions.what_it_is: Transfer the fee interest with the remaining lease term intact.
decisions.when_it_wins: Only if verified as-is quotes plus a CPA after-tax computation exceed the verified hold-case present value by a margin that covers transacton risk.
decisions.when_it_loses: If no verified comps, if tax basis is unverified, or if a short-lease discount is being guessed.

decisions.what_it_is: Hold rent for a period, then market the asset.
decisions.when_it_wins: Only if verified rent escalations exceed the term-erosion discount; requires a dated notice calendar.
decisions.when_it_loses: Term erosion, tenant non-renewal and a weaker buyer pool can compound; no official source publishes this parcel's discount.

decisions.what_it_is: Extend the NNN lease on verified terms with a creditworthy counterparty.
decisions.when_it_wins: If verified renewal rent, guaranty and hazard/insurance costs produce a higher risk-adjusted hold value than the after-tax sale case.
decisions.when_it_loses: If tenant credit, same-store trajectory and closure programmes are unfavourable and no rent protection is verified.

decisions.option: Hold without renewal (roll the lease to expiry)
decisions.what_it_is: Collect rent until expiry, then re-tenant or redevelop.
decisions.when_it_wins: Only with verified re-tenanting demand and capital budget.
decisions.when_it_loses: Vacancy, lost rent, repairs and exit-liquidity stress must be modelled jointly.

decisions.what_it_is: Replace the operator or convert the improvement.
decisions.when_it_wins: If official zoning permits the use and verified local demand supports it.
decisions.when_it_loses: Entitlement, construction and downtime costs are unverified.

decisions.option: Sell and reinvest via a like-kind exchange
decisions.what_it_is: Defer gain with a qualifying section 1031 replacement.
decisions.when_it_wins: Only if real-property, timing and qualified-intermediary rules are verifiably met.
decisions.when_it_loses: 45-day identification and 180-day receipt deadlines create execution risk; California still taxes gains as ordinary income.

decisions.when_it_wins: If verified debt terms and coverage support the hold case.
decisions.when_it_loses: Leverage amplifies black-swan and vacancy losses; no loan terms supplied.

decisions.what_it_is: Sell a partial interest while retaining exposure.
decisions.when_it_wins: If verified partnership terms preserve control and liquidity.
decisions.when_it_loses: Governance and exit-liquidity complexity; no terms supplied.

decisions.what_it_is: Keep collecting rent and postpone analysis.
decisions.when_it_wins: Preserves optionality only while the notice calendar is verified.
decisions.when_it_loses: Silently loses option and notice windows; the 2030–2035 range is not a verified date.
decisions.status: NOT ADVISED without a verified notice calendar

decisions.what_it_is: Commit to no sale or renewal; run a time-boxed verification programme for both cases in parallel.
decisions.when_it_wins: It is the only decision that is defensible with the information that currently exists; it preserves wealth optionality without an irreversible bet.
decisions.when_it_loses: It is not a transaction outcome; it must have a hard deadline tied to the verified expiry and notice dates.
decisions.status: RECOMMENDED PROCESS DECISION — not a sale/renewal winner

questions.question: What is the exact lease expiration date?
questions.needed: Executed lease, all amendments, commencement certificate.
questions.discovery: Attorney lease abstract; reconcile with the notice calendar privately.

questions.question: What renewal options exist and when must notice be given?
questions.needed: Option clauses, notice addresses, delivery method, cure periods.
questions.discovery: Clause-by-clause abstract; calendar every deadline with an owner.

questions.question: What are current rent, escalations and any percentage rent?
questions.needed: Rent schedule, CPI or fixed bumps, sales reports.
questions.discovery: Private rent-roll reconciliation against the lease.

questions.question: Who guarantees the lease and what is their credit?
questions.needed: Guaranty, entity filings, financial statements.
questions.discovery: Private estoppel certificate and credit review.

questions.question: Are there co-tenancy, assignment, ROFR or holdover clauses?
questions.needed: Full lease text.
questions.discovery: Attorney abstract with a clause matrix.

questions.question: Which APN, legal description and jurisdiction apply?
questions.needed: Deed, Assessor record, city/county boundary confirmation.
questions.discovery: Private Assessor lookup; never publish the identifier.

questions.question: What is the zoning, land-use designation and entitlement history?
questions.needed: ZIMAS/ZIMAS-equivalent record, community plan, case numbers.
questions.discovery: Private zoning search and official case search.

questions.question: What would a buyer pay today as-is?
questions.needed: At least three dated written broker opinions and closed comparable sales.
questions.discovery: Private RFP to licensed brokers; record terms and dates.

questions.question: What is the short-lease discount from real quotes?
questions.needed: Paired quotes for short vs long remaining term.
questions.discovery: Request paired, dated quotes; publish only an aggregate conclusion.

questions.question: What renewal rent and term will the tenant actually sign?
questions.needed: Written term sheet and credit review.
questions.discovery: Private negotiation; do not assume a renewal.

questions.question: What cap rate, discount rate and exit-liquidity haircut are supportable?
questions.needed: Verified comparable sales and the owner's required return.
questions.discovery: Derive in the private model; label as assumptions.

questions.question: What is adjusted basis and accumulated depreciation?
questions.needed: Acquisition records, cost segregation, prior returns.
questions.discovery: CPA reconstruction offline.

questions.question: What are the owner's marginal rates and MAGI?
questions.needed: Private tax profile.
questions.discovery: CPA computation; calculator input stays in the browser.

questions.question: Is a section 1031 exchange feasible and are the deadlines achievable?
questions.needed: Qualified intermediary, replacement property pipeline.
questions.discovery: Tax counsel opinion; track 45/180-day rules.

questions.question: What is the actual assessed value and tax bill?
questions.needed: Assessor and Treasurer records for the parcel.
questions.discovery: Private lookup; Prop 13 rules are verified.

questions.question: What is the FEMA flood zone and elevation status?
questions.needed: MSC address search, elevation certificate, flood quote.
questions.discovery: Private lookup plus insurance quote.

questions.question: What is the CAL FIRE FHSZ status and map version?
questions.needed: Official FHSZ viewer lookup with map date.
questions.discovery: Private lookup; note the 2026 SRA public comment period.

questions.question: Is the parcel in an Alquist-Priolo, liquefaction or landslide zone?
questions.needed: EQ ZApp lookup and geotechnical report.
questions.discovery: Private lookup; note seller disclosure duties.

questions.question: What do engineering and insurance actually cost and exclude?
questions.needed: Property condition report, seismic assessment, two insurance quotes.
questions.discovery: Private procurement; compare deductibles and exclusions.

questions.question: How do lost rent, repairs and impaired exit liquidity interact?
questions.needed: Joint stress model with verified inputs.
questions.discovery: Run in the versioned model after inputs exist; label illustrative.

questions.question: Which Census tract set defines the trade area?
questions.needed: Private parcel anchor and a documented boundary method.
questions.discovery: Use OnTheMap / ACS geography privately; lock tract IDs and vintages.

questions.question: What are tract-level population and income trends?
questions.needed: ACS 5-year profiles for locked tracts, multi-year series.
questions.discovery: Query with a registered API key; keep regional figures alongside.

questions.question: Which schools serve the parcel and how are they trending?
questions.needed: Attendance boundaries; enrollment and dashboard series.
questions.discovery: Private boundary lookup, then official CDE DataQuest pulls.

questions.question: What are nearby traffic volumes and their multi-year direction?
questions.needed: PeMS District 7 station selection and multi-year aggregates.
questions.discovery: Private station selection; note PeMS upgrade limitations.

questions.question: What competing QSR supply and local planning actions exist?
questions.needed: Competitor inventory, official case and permit history.
questions.discovery: Private field survey plus official case search.

questions.question: Are regional jobs and population growing or shrinking?
questions.needed: BLS/EDD/Census/DOF series over multiple periods.
questions.answer: Verified regional series are published on the Economy page; they are not parcel-level.
questions.discovery: Extend the series each release; keep tract-level series separate.

questions.question: Is the brand's direction improving or deteriorating?
questions.needed: Multi-year same-store sales, unit counts, closures, franchise rental revenue.
questions.answer: Verified FY2023–FY2025 and quarterly series are published on the Operator page.
questions.discovery: Update each 10-K/8-K; never use one quarter as a trend.

questions.question: Can a projection be back-tested against sufficient history?
questions.needed: Verified comparable ledger and realised outcomes.
questions.discovery: Build a dated comparable ledger privately before claiming reliability.

questions.question: What wealth-preservation and growth balance is right for the owner?
questions.needed: Private objectives, liquidity, concentration and risk tolerance.
questions.discovery: Private fiduciary discussion; no owner data published.

questions.question: When is the hard decision deadline?
questions.needed: Verified expiry, option windows and marketing lead time.
questions.discovery: Set a private deadline once G-1 closes; review gates monthly.

requirements.note: Documented as a private-only workflow; no location published.

requirements.text: Privately check seismic, flood and fire maps, engineering and insurance; stress loss of rent, repairs and exit liquidity together.
requirements.note: Joint-stress library published with unverified magnitudes.

requirements.note: Regional context retained as context only; parcel status blank and flagged.

requirements.text: A series of same-store sales, unit counts, closures and franchise rental revenue shows direction, not one quarter.
requirements.note: FY2023–FY2025 plus quarterly series from official SEC filings.

requirements.text: Create an executive summary outlining important details.
requirements.note: Executive Summary page with the current process decision.

requirements.text: Make suggestions on how to improve the site to improve decision making, and create a dedicated section so someone can review suggestions and choose the best path before implementing changes.
requirements.note: Suggestions page with an in-browser reviewer selection board and memo export.

requirements.text: A clear list of questions, information and answers that need to be addressed before any decision can reasonably be made, with suggestions to discover missing information.
requirements.note: Thirty questions with information needed, answer, discovery path, official link and status.

requirements.text: Personal information privacy is top priority; anonymize personal information, use placeholders, and never publish personal information discovered during research.
requirements.note: Automated scan plus a published privacy policy.

requirements.text: Determine the best course of action: sell before expiry or renew, for an NNN Jack in the Box lease expiring 2030–2035 around central Los Angeles.
requirements.note: No transaction winner is defensible; a verification-first reversible hold is published as the process decision.

requirements.text: Look at every factor that could affect value: geography, income, schools, population, job growth and local economy; deep research toward a reliable projection system.
requirements.note: Verified regional factors and official tract/school/traffic portals published; projection back-test blocked.

requirements.text: Risks for every possible decision and a wealth-preserving, growth-oriented balance with manageable risk.
requirements.note: Decision matrix, risk register and black-swan scenarios.

requirements.text: Account for business-as-usual events and rare black swan events such as wildfires or natural disasters; use verified official sources.
requirements.note: Scenario library cites FEMA, CAL FIRE, USGS, CGS and CDI.

requirements.text: No manual input from the user; work line by line from official trusted sources with no hallucinations.
requirements.note: All published values transcribed from official sources; unverified cells are blank.

requirements.text: Review the repo line by line, provide links for manual review, flag irregularities.
requirements.note: Repo Review page plus verification report.

requirements.text: Create a GitHub Pages live site with a clean landing page, subpages by category, simple dashboard UI, tables for all entries and findings, and analysis.
requirements.note: audit/ dashboard with 22 pages, every data row source-linked.

requirements.text: Verify line by line; every table row has a source link to an official site; unverified values blank and flagged; never infer or fill values.
requirements.note: Enforced by verification/check.py; results in REPORT.md.

requirements.text: Use COORDINATION.md as a shared board, claim scopes, avoid conflicts, small frequent commits, pull --rebase before every push, resolve conflicts without discarding others' work, log sources and verification.
requirements.note: Scope revised to unclaimed audit/ + verification/; conflicts logged.

suggestions.proposal: Give every table row an explicit source ID, retrieval date and official URL (not a generic 'Official reference' link).
suggestions.rationale: Generic links do not support the claim in each row; row-level provenance is auditable.

suggestions.proposal: Add a machine-readable dataset and a validator that fails the build on missing source links or unflagged blank values.
suggestions.rationale: Automated line-by-line verification prevents silent inference.

suggestions.proposal: Publish a versioned change log and a retrieval date on every page.
suggestions.rationale: Official series are revised (BLS marks data preliminary); readers need the vintage.

suggestions.proposal: Add a print stylesheet and a one-page advisor brief that contains no identifiers.
suggestions.rationale: Advisers need a shareable summary without exposing private records.

suggestions.proposal: Add an in-browser reviewer board that lets a person shortlist suggestions and choose a path before implementation, with no network calls or persistence.
suggestions.rationale: Keeps the decision gate explicit and preserves privacy.

suggestions.proposal: Separate OBSERVATION / ASSUMPTION / UNVERIFIED badges on every value.
suggestions.rationale: Prevents assumptions from being mistaken for verified facts.

suggestions.proposal: Commission a private lease abstract and build a dated notice calendar before any commitment.
suggestions.rationale: The 2030–2035 window is unverified; every other gate depends on it.

suggestions.proposal: Fix the trade area privately, lock tract IDs and vintages, then pull ACS/LEHD/OnTheMap series.
suggestions.rationale: City and county proxies do not measure the property's neighbourhood.

suggestions.proposal: Run parcel flood, fire and seismic lookups and record the map version and date.
suggestions.rationale: CAL FIRE's 2026 SRA update is in public comment; zone status can change.

suggestions.proposal: Obtain at least three dated, written broker quotes for as-is and renewed cases and paired short-lease quotes.
suggestions.rationale: No official source publishes the short-lease discount for this parcel.

suggestions.proposal: Have a CPA produce a private after-tax computation, including California ordinary-rate treatment and depreciation recapture.
suggestions.rationale: California provides no preferential capital-gain rate; owner inputs are private.

suggestions.proposal: Build a dated comparable-sales ledger and back-test the cash-flow model before trusting any projection.
suggestions.rationale: A projection without sufficient verified history is an assumption, not evidence.

suggestions.proposal: Extend the issuer series each quarter and annually; never conclude direction from one quarter.
suggestions.rationale: Same-store sales, closures and rental revenue move over multiple years.

suggestions.proposal: Stress lost rent, repairs, insurance deductibles and exit liquidity together, including wildfire, earthquake and flood scenarios.
suggestions.rationale: Joint stress matters more than isolated single-peril estimates.

suggestions.proposal: Verify tenant credit and any guaranty privately before treating renewal as the low-risk path.
suggestions.rationale: Issuer-level closures and same-store declines do not identify the actual tenant entity.

suggestions.proposal: Set a hard, privately recorded decision deadline tied to the verified expiry and option windows; review gates monthly.
suggestions.rationale: Deferral without a deadline silently destroys options.

suggestions.proposal: Run an automated personal-information scan on every published file before each deploy.
suggestions.rationale: Privacy is the highest-urgency requirement; manual review alone is insufficient.

suggestions.proposal: Consolidate the incompatible COORDINATION.md boards into one append-only board that preserves every session's rows.
suggestions.rationale: Multiple sessions created different board schemas; merges risk discarding claims.

risks.effect: A sale can lock in a discount based on an assumed short-lease penalty and an uncomputed tax bill.
risks.mitigation: Do not commit until dated quotes and a CPA computation exist; keep both cases on the same valuation date.

risks.effect: California taxes capital gains as ordinary income, so a federal-only estimate understates the bill.
risks.mitigation: Include the ordinary-rate treatment and any NIIT in the after-tax module.

risks.effect: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain can be taxed at up to 25%, changing net proceeds.
risks.mitigation: CPA reconstructs the depreciation schedule privately.

risks.effect: A shortening remaining term changes the buyer pool; no official source publishes the size of that discount.
risks.mitigation: Price the short-lease discount from dated real quotes.

risks.effect: Missing an option or notice deadline can remove negotiating leverage.
risks.mitigation: Reconcile lease abstract with a dated notice calendar.

risks.effect: Issuer system same-store sales fell in FY2024 and FY2025 and FY2025 closures exceeded openings; the actual tenant entity is unverified.
risks.mitigation: Obtain an estoppel certificate, guaranty and financials privately.

risks.effect: A renewal priced on an assumed rent can underperform the sale case.
risks.mitigation: Require a written term sheet before comparing.

risks.effect: Lost rent plus repairs plus impaired exit liquidity must be stressed together, not separately.
risks.mitigation: Joint-stress scenario in the versioned model once inputs are verified.

risks.effect: A change of use may not be permitted; permit history is parcel-specific.
risks.mitigation: Private official zoning and case search.

risks.effect: 45-day identification and 180-day receipt rules are strict; failure creates an unexpected tax bill.
risks.mitigation: Engage a qualified intermediary and track deadlines privately.

risks.effect: Debt amplifies vacancy and disaster losses; no loan terms are verified.
risks.mitigation: Verify coverage under stressed rent assumptions before leveraging.

risks.effect: A 2030–2035 unverified range is not a date; deferral can consume the marketing window.
risks.mitigation: Set a hard private decision deadline.

risks.effect: Publishing an address, APN, lease file or owner figure cannot be undone and may trigger CCPA/CPRA duties.
risks.mitigation: Access-controlled offline workspace, placeholders and an automated pre-deploy scan.

risks.effect: City/county figures can point the wrong way for a single parcel; county population declined while metro jobs grew.
risks.mitigation: Replace proxies with locked tract-level series.

risks.effect: Fire Hazard Severity Zones classify expected hazard; a severe event can damage the improvement, interrupt rent and narrow the buyer pool simultaneously.
risks.mitigation: Private FHSZ lookup, insurance review and hardening; stress the joint loss.

risks.effect: Ground shaking, liquefaction or fault rupture can cause structural loss and disclosure obligations at resale.
risks.mitigation: EQ ZApp lookup, geotechnical review, CEA/insurance assessment.

risks.effect: Flood damage is generally excluded from standard property policies; a separate NFIP policy has a typical 30-day waiting period.
risks.mitigation: MSC zone lookup, elevation certificate, bind coverage before a loss event.

risks.effect: The FAIR Plan is an insurer of last resort; reliance on it may mean higher cost and coverage limitations.
risks.mitigation: Obtain at least two admitted-market quotes and compare exclusions.

risks.effect: Employment, population and income trends can reverse; a single-tenant asset concentrates the risk.
risks.mitigation: Track the official series over multiple periods; diversify exposure after a verified sale case.

risks.effect: Local CPI-U and repair-cost inflation can erode NNN economics if any landlord obligations exist.
risks.mitigation: Verify lease expense allocations privately and stress repairs.

risks.effect: Road changes, rezoning or competitor entry can shift accessibility and trade-area demand.
risks.mitigation: Pull official PeMS and planning case history for the private trade area.

risks.effect: Enrollment and household composition influence daytime and evening demand.
risks.mitigation: Official CDE DataQuest series for the attendance area.

risks.effect: A projection built without sufficient comparable history can appear precise while being unsupported.
risks.mitigation: Version the model, separate observations from assumptions, back-test, and block a winner until then.

risks.effect: BLS October 2026 figures are preliminary; CAL FIRE maps are being updated; assessments change on ownership transfer.
risks.mitigation: Record retrieval dates and map versions; re-verify before a commitment.
